title: Midnight Jelly Custard Dumplings
description: A unique Chinese dessert inspired by midnight cravings, featuring jelly and custard fillings in a delicate dumpling wrapper.
instructions: Combine flour and water in a bowl to make the dumpling dough. Knead for 10 minutes.
Cut the dough into small pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a small spoonful of jelly in the center of each dumpling wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
In a separate pan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the egg yolks and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Add the confectioners' sugar and mix well.
Fill each dumpling with a spoonful of the egg yolk mixture.
Serve the dumplings warm, dust with confectioners' sugar.
